```plato
    //==
    // Vector2D — transformation

    // Apply a 2D affine map, including the translation row (Row3).
    Transform(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix3x2): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + matrix.Row3.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + matrix.Row3.Y);
```

```plato
    // Apply the 2D part of a homogeneous map, including the translation row
    // (Row4): (X M11 + Y M21 + M41, X M12 + Y M22 + M42).
    Transform(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix4x4): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + matrix.Row4.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + matrix.Row4.Y);
```

```plato
    // Rotate the vector by a quaternion, treating it as the z = 0 vector and
    // dropping the resulting z. The doubled-component expansion of the sandwich
    // product q v q*. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation
    Transform(self: Vector2D, rotation: Quaternion): Vector2D {
        var x2 = rotation.X + rotation.X;
        var y2 = rotation.Y + rotation.Y;
        var z2 = rotation.Z + rotation.Z;
        var wz2 = rotation.W * z2;
        var xx2 = rotation.X * x2;
        var xy2 = rotation.X * y2;
        var yy2 = rotation.Y * y2;
        var zz2 = rotation.Z * z2;
        return (self.X * (1.0 - yy2 - zz2) + self.Y * (xy2 - wz2),
                self.X * (xy2 + wz2) + self.Y * (1.0 - xx2 - zz2));
    }
```

```plato
    //==
    // Vector3D — transformation

    // Apply a homogeneous map, including the translation row (Row4):
    // v' = x Row1 + y Row2 + z Row3 + Row4, dropping the w component.
    Transform(self: Vector3D, matrix: Matrix4x4): Vector3D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + self.Z * matrix.Row3.X + matrix.Row4.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Y + matrix.Row4.Y,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Z + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Z + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Z + matrix.Row4.Z);
```

```plato
    // Rotate the vector by a quaternion: the doubled-component expansion of the
    // sandwich product q v q*.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation
    Transform(self: Vector3D, rotation: Quaternion): Vector3D {
        var x2 = rotation.X + rotation.X;
        var y2 = rotation.Y + rotation.Y;
        var z2 = rotation.Z + rotation.Z;
        var wx2 = rotation.W * x2;
        var wy2 = rotation.W * y2;
        var wz2 = rotation.W * z2;
        var xx2 = rotation.X * x2;
        var xy2 = rotation.X * y2;
        var xz2 = rotation.X * z2;
        var yy2 = rotation.Y * y2;
        var yz2 = rotation.Y * z2;
        var zz2 = rotation.Z * z2;
        return (self.X * (1.0 - yy2 - zz2) + self.Y * (xy2 - wz2) + self.Z * (xz2 + wy2),
                self.X * (xy2 + wz2) + self.Y * (1.0 - xx2 - zz2) + self.Z * (yz2 - wx2),
                self.X * (xz2 - wy2) + self.Y * (yz2 + wx2) + self.Z * (1.0 - xx2 - yy2));
    }
```

```plato

    //==
    // # Number4 — homogeneous transforms
    //
    // Row-vector convention: v' = v M, so component j of the result pairs the
    // whole of v with COLUMN j of the matrix (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md -
    // Matrices). Rows are Number4, so M(i,j) is Row<i>.<j-th field>: M11 is
    // Row1.X, M21 is Row2.X, and so on.

    // The 4-vector carried through a 4x4 transform, treating it as a homogeneous
    // coordinate: no perspective divide, W is produced by the fourth column.
    Transform(self: Number4, matrix: Matrix4x4): Number4
        => (
            self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + self.Z * matrix.Row3.X + self.W * matrix.Row4.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Y + self.W * matrix.Row4.Y,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Z + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Z + self.Z * matrix.Row3.Z + self.W * matrix.Row4.Z,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.W + self.Y * matrix.Row2.W + self.Z * matrix.Row3.W + self.W * matrix.Row4.W);
```

```plato

    // The 4-vector whose XYZ part is rotated by a unit quaternion, with W passed
    // through untouched. The coefficients are the quaternion-to-matrix identity
    // written inline (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation),
    // matching System.Numerics term for term.
    Transform(self: Number4, rotation: Quaternion): Number4
    {
        var x2 = rotation.X + rotation.X;
        var y2 = rotation.Y + rotation.Y;
        var z2 = rotation.Z + rotation.Z;
        var wx2 = rotation.W * x2;
        var wy2 = rotation.W * y2;
        var wz2 = rotation.W * z2;
        var xx2 = rotation.X * x2;
        var xy2 = rotation.X * y2;
        var xz2 = rotation.X * z2;
        var yy2 = rotation.Y * y2;
        var yz2 = rotation.Y * z2;
        var zz2 = rotation.Z * z2;
        return (
            self.X * (1.0 - yy2 - zz2) + self.Y * (xy2 - wz2) + self.Z * (xz2 + wy2),
            self.X * (xy2 + wz2) + self.Y * (1.0 - xx2 - zz2) + self.Z * (yz2 - wx2),
            self.X * (xz2 - wy2) + self.Y * (yz2 + wx2) + self.Z * (1.0 - xx2 - yy2),
            self.W);
    }
```
